Thanks Mateo — copying over the technical notes from our call and a recommended auth path.

Summary (short): for a quick POC we recommend short-lived JWTs minted by a Redwood service account with customer KMS-managed wrapping for production. For initial dev work we can provide a time-limited API key (dev-only) that maps to a sandbox project.

Why this combo?
- Short-lived JWTs reduce blast radius; keys are rotated at the token issuer layer rather than embedding long-lived secrets in the client.
- Customer KMS (optional) gives LedgerCo control of root material for compliance; Redwood supports Bring-Your-Own-KMS (BYOK) via our Private offering.
- Audit logging: every token mint and API call can be logged to your SIEM (we can forward CloudTrail-style logs or supply a JSON webhook).

Technical checklist (dev -> prod):
- Dev: issue ephemeral API key (30d TTL) mapped to sandbox project; SDK sample available.
- POC: integrate SDK + embeddings, use short-lived JWT (24h by default) signed by Redwood service account; rotate signing keys every 7 days (configurable).
- Prod: BYOK + HSM option; enforce rotate-on-read for service account keys; enable token introspection endpoint for session validation.

Quick SDK snippet (Node):
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ auth: { type: 'jwt', token: process.env.REDWOOD_JWT } });
// embeddings example...

I'll attach the short "redwood-auth-checklist.pdf" with the decision matrix. If you want, we can also run an internal script that generates a sample service-account JWT and a one-minute demo token for LedgerCo to validate locally.

Thanks Priyanka — answers inline and a proposed MAP below.

Q1 — Audit logs / Splunk: Redwood can stream call-level JSON logs (timestamp, request_id, model, route, auth_subject, action) to an S3 bucket or to a webhook endpoint. We also support forwarding to Splunk HEC; sample log schema attached in the redwood-auth-checklist.pdf.

Q2 — BYOK lead time: BYOK for Private deployments typically takes 4–6 weeks (key exchange, onboarding, and testing). For Hosted with customer-managed KMS options (we do hybrid), we can enable a BYOK flow in ~2 weeks if LedgerCo provides KMS access + standard attestation. We'll capture this in the MAP.

Q3 — Token expiry: we are flexible. For POC we can issue 1h tokens (recommended) and rotate signing keys every 3 days during the POC; for production we recommend 24h tokens with 7-day signing-key rotation as a starting point you can tighten.

Service account owner: Vanessa will be the primary Redwood technical contact for the service account (vanessa@redwood.com). I'll be the commercial owner for the deal.

Mutual Action Plan (proposed):
- Week 0 (by Mon, Feb 15): LedgerCo confirms hosted keys vs BYOK and signs MAP (Priyanka).
- Week 1 (Feb 16-22): Redwood provides sandbox API key + sample SDK, and issues 1h demo JWT generator for LedgerCo (Vanessa).
- Week 2 (Feb 23-28): Integration POC (embeddings + reranker) run by LedgerCo; Redwood on-call for troubleshooting (Vanessa/Ben).
- Week 3 (Mar 1-7): Production gating: audit log integration test and BYOK enablement planning if moving to prod (Mateo/Vanessa).

Attachments: ledgerco-integration-checklist.xlsx, redwood-auth-checklist.pdf, integration-diagram.png.

Please reply with a one-line approval on the MAP and whether you want us to proceed with 1h tokens for the POC. If that's good, I'll open the HubSpot tasks and drop a DocuSign MAP link.
